paths.title: Hyper-V Virtualization Specialist
paths.target_role: Hyper-V Engineer / Senior Wintel Engineer / Virtualization Engineer
entry_prerequisites: Working knowledge of Windows Server, networking and enterprise change control

milestones.rationale: Establish Hyper-V architecture, host readiness and shared failure-domain reasoning before operational work.
Build virtual-network design, read-only evidence collection and evidence-first incident diagnosis.
Validate scenario judgement and senior production reasoning before integration.
Integrate readiness, resilience, networking and change-safety evidence in one production assurance exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Progresses from platform architecture to operational evidence, then scenario judgement and integrated production-readiness assurance.
paths.status_rationale: The physical corpus covers architecture, host readiness, virtual networking, read-only diagnostics, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated capstone. Advanced clustering/storage scenarios remain future enrichment rather than a prerequisite for the core path.

paths.title: HGS / Shielded VM Security Specialist
paths.target_role: Guarded Fabric Engineer / Senior Virtualization Engineer / Security Architect
entry_prerequisites: Strong Hyper-V fundamentals and enterprise identity/security change-control awareness

milestones.rationale: Establish guarded-fabric trust boundaries and attestation models before troubleshooting or recovery.
Connect key release, recovery dependencies and read-only attestation diagnostics.
Validate senior security and recovery judgement.
Integrate trust, attestation, privileged separation and DR assurance into one guarded-fabric exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Trust architecture precedes attestation operations; recovery and troubleshooting follow only after the learner can explain the authorization boundary.
paths.status_rationale: The path has physical coverage across HGS architecture, attestation, shielded operations, evidence collection, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated trust/recovery capstone.

paths.title: SCVMM Fabric Engineering Specialist
paths.target_role: SCVMM Engineer / Senior Wintel Engineer / Infrastructure Architect
entry_prerequisites: Hyper-V and failover-cluster fundamentals plus enterprise networking/storage awareness

milestones.rationale: Establish VMM architecture, HA dependencies and compute-fabric onboarding boundaries.
Build network/storage/library abstraction reasoning and evidence-first reconciliation.
Validate senior management-plane and fabric judgement.
Integrate HA, reconciliation, abstraction accuracy and layered troubleshooting into one fabric assurance exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Learners must understand VMM as a management plane over Hyper-V before using its abstractions for automation or remediation decisions.
paths.status_rationale: The path has physical coverage across SCVMM architecture, compute fabric, network/storage/library abstractions, read-only reconciliation, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated fabric capstone.

paths.title: PowerShell Infrastructure Automation Specialist
paths.target_role: PowerShell Engineer / Senior Infrastructure Engineer / DevOps Engineer
entry_prerequisites: Basic Windows administration and scripting familiarity

milestones.rationale: Establish object-first pipeline and reusable-function design.
Add remoting security, production error semantics, observability and read-only diagnostics.
Validate failure diagnosis and senior automation judgement.
Integrate object design, remoting, error handling, evidence, rollout and compensation into a production automation exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Object and function design comes first; secure remoting and error semantics follow; mutation design is last and remains bounded by evidence and change authority.
paths.status_rationale: The path has physical coverage across object pipelines, functions, remoting/security, error semantics, read-only diagnostics, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated automation-safety capstone.
